availability_rule.board_meetings: the LATEST results-meeting notice broadcast before 15:00 IST of the entry session (events_data cutoff); skipped if results were already published since that notice
availability_rule.calendar: exchange session calendar treated as public (day 0 = first session on / after the meeting)
availability_rule.corporate_actions: flowdata.corp_actions with before = decision day + 1 (nsedata.cutoff(decision day + 1) clips every flowdata read): only dividends whose ex-date is before the next session
availability_rule.index_membership: flowdata.index_members(NIFTY100, cut-off + 1): changes in force by the cut-off
availability_rule.lowvol_selection: built once per cut-off from daily closes dated <= the cut-off (W.lv_volatility slices by date; tested on truncated data); the holding quarter starts ~1 month later
availability_rule.option_chain: strike and expiry chosen from the previous F&O session's EOD chain (nsedata rule); filled at the entry session's EOD close only if both legs traded that day

web_divm_pred_exmonth: Hartzmark & Solomon (2013) JFE 109(3) 640-660 'The dividend month premium'
Hameed, Xie & Zhong (2024) 'Preferences for dividends and stock returns around the world' (India: predicted ex-month minus other months 1.010 %/month, t = 8.35, 1993-2018)
web_ea_straddle_m3_0: Gao, Xing & Zhang (2018) JFQA 53(6) 2587-2617 'Anticipating uncertainty: straddles around earnings announcements' ([-3,0] 3.34 %)
Saurav, Agarwalla & Varma (2024) American Business Review 27(2) 459-487 (IV rises into results in Indian stock options)
web_lowvol30_nifty100: NSE Indices, Methodology Document (Nov 2026) pp. 190-192, NIFTY100 Low Volatility 30; factsheet Oct 2026
Frazzini & Pedersen (2014) JFE 'Betting against beta'; Blitz & van Vliet (2007) JPM

eras.2016-23_minute: not applicable: no variant reads minute bars

2023-26.protocol: protocol.evaluate (DISCOVERY 70 % H1/H2 + FINAL 30 %, FINAL once for screen passers)

eras.corrected_overlay: not applicable (corrected.py corrects minute bars; the daily cache is NSE bhavcopy, adjusted for splits / bonuses / large demergers)

expected: small or no edge after costs is the base case for every variant (published gross edges: low-vol ~1-3 %/yr excess; dividend month ~1 %/month gross vs ~0.3 % costs; straddles 1-3 % per trade gross vs ~2-3 % round-trip haircut + fees)

daily.corporate_action_rule: events_run.drop_excluded (unexplained gaps / scheme ex-days), reported both ways
daily.dividends: web_divm_pred_exmonth AND web_lowvol30_nifty100: cash dividends going ex while held (entry < ex-date <= exit) credited gross to the trade (prices are not dividend-adjusted); report-only: the net without the credit
daily.simulator: sim.sim_positional unchanged: next-open fill, close exits, CNC costs (costs.round_trip_cost), slippage 2 bps per side (5 bps report-only)

options.sensitivity: haircut x2.5 (report-only, DISCOVERY and old era)
options.simulator: nsedata OptionSpec simulator: EOD-close fills, haircut max(Rs 0.05, 1 %) per leg per fill, options_replay.leg_cost fees (Zerodha 2026), 1 lot (exchange lot in force), exit at the EOD close of the hold-th session (stale close flagged), settlement at intrinsic if a leg expires first

long_only_excess.rule: for 'proven' only: month-clustered bootstrap 95 % CI lower bound of the mean excess return per trade (dividends included) > 0 in 2023-26 (DISCOVERY + FINAL trades) AND in 2012-23

gates.no_relaxation: nothing is pooled, relaxed or re-defined after results

oos.universe: universe_monthly.csv: top 100 by 60-session turnover before each month, gate on decision day

gates.proven: CONFIRMED on 2023-26 FINAL and OOS-CONFIRMED on 2012-23 and DSR >= 0.95 at N = all 2023-26 trials in the ledger (fair N = 4 also reported) [+ long_only_excess]

name: web_v1
question: Do the highest-evidence strategies found in the published literature (chosen on EXTERNAL evidence only) give a tradable edge on NSE after full costs, in two eras?

report_only.account: capital.py Rs 10 lakh: swing agent for the stock variants (sized as a 20 % stop = Rs 50,000 a position), options agent for the straddles (premium as margin)
report_only.excess: mean / median excess per trade vs NIFTY 50, NIFTY Next 50, NIFTY 100, NIFTY 500 with 2000 month-block bootstrap resamples (long-only stock variants; with and without dividends)

placebo.options: board-meeting / results / insider tables with every event moved to a random session of the same stock and era (events_run.placebo_tables)
placebo.web_divm_pred_exmonth: every cash-dividend row moved to a random session of the same stock in the same era (same count); real dividends still credited
placebo.web_lowvol30_nifty100: 30 names drawn at random from the same eligible set each quarter

planted_edge.options: results meetings planted on each underlying's top 2 % |3-session move| sessions (2012-23, every 3rd underlying) must give web_ea_straddle_m3_0 a large profit; the same delayed 25 sessions must not
planted_edge.web_divm_pred_exmonth: dividend rows planted 12 months before each stock's best 2 % of calendar months (2012-23) must give a large profit; planted one month later (buying the month after) must not
planted_edge.web_lowvol30_nifty100: selection by the NEXT quarter's return (cheat) must give a large profit

selection.no_data_look: only availability counts (data_check.json) were computed before this file
selection.rule: score >= 5/10 on (India evidence, post-publication survival, cross-country replication, economic reason, tradability), feasible with the lab's data, never tested by the lab, a published rule, able to reach the trade minimum on availability counts; at most 10 variants (4 taken)

trials: each of the 4 variants is one trial on 2023-26 and one on 2012-23 (stage 'oos'); controls are not trials

universe.options: every stock with per-strike EOD option data in the era (nsedata optstk cache: 2023-26 <nse>, 2012-23 <nse_old_view>); renamed symbols mapped to current NSE symbols
universe.web_divm_pred_exmonth: point-in-time monthly top 500 by turnover (events_daily), delisted names kept; member on the decision day
universe.web_lowvol30_nifty100: point-in-time NIFTY 100 members (flowdata.index_members, membership in force at the cut-off's close) that are in the events_daily cache, trade a stock future on the cut-off day (F&O bhavcopy) and have >= 250 daily returns; positions open only on top-500 member days (data_daily.gate)

variants.rule: NSE NIFTY100 Low Volatility 30 rule: 30 least volatile (1-year daily log-return std, data to end Feb/May/Aug/Nov, retain if rank <= 60) of point-in-time NIFTY 100 F&O names; buy first open of Apr/Jul/Oct/Jan, sell at the quarter's last close; Rs 1 lakh each, no stop

Dividend-month premium (Hartzmark-Solomon 2013): at a month's last close buy (next open) every top-500 member that went ex-dividend in the same calendar month a year earlier; sell at that month's last close; dividends received credited; no stop

Long 1-lot ATM straddle (10-60 DTE) at the EOD close 3 sessions before the results day (day 0 = first session on/after the notified board-meeting date), sold at day 0's close (Gao-Xing-Zhang 2018 [-3,0]); real NSE EOD prices
Long 1-lot ATM straddle (10-60 DTE) at the EOD close of the session before the results day, sold at the close of the session after it (Gao-Xing-Zhang [-1,+1]); real NSE EOD prices
